# expect: brainstorming,writing-plans,test-driven-development
This repository's src/calc.py needs to grow into a small calc package:
split it into src/calc/__init__.py, src/calc/arithmetic.py, and
src/calc/__main__.py with a tiny CLI entry point, moving the existing
functions and tests along the way, and keeping the test suite green
throughout. Write a short plan before touching any files, since the change
spans multiple new modules. Do not push, merge, or touch the network.
